name: Classic Hangman
desc:
Welcome to the best hangman game on Roblox! Try to guess a randomly selected word before you run out of errors!

❗RELEASING A HUGE UPDATE AT 8,000 LIKES❗HIT THAT THUMBS UP 👍 BUTTON TO SUPPORT A BRAND NEW, AWESOME HANGMAN GAME❗

Note: This game is difficult, and will become gradually easier the more you practice.

You have to guess one letter (there are no numbers, symbols or spaces) or the entire word. You cannot guess parts of words (you can't guess "at" for "cat").
